It offers 80 Plus Gold efficiency rating, full modular cables, premium FDB fan, 100% Japanese high-quality capacitors. And it features superior full bridge LLC resonant converter together with DC-DC circuitry, put this product on the mountain top for gold power supply.   --> HIGH EFFICIENCY AND LOWER OPERATING COSTS Century series is certified 80 PLUS® Gold, it can effectively save energy consumption and guaranties a minimum of 90 % efficiency at 50% load, producing less heat generation. Also, the series has been optimized with all generations of Intel's processors to maximize energy saving. --> MODERN CIRCUIT LAYOUT DELIVERS SUPERIOR PERFORMANCE Century series uses a full bridge LLC resonant converter framework together with DC-DC circuity, plus 100% Japanese capacitors and all high- quality components. Making the Century Series power supply reliable for safety and stable voltage outputs, better performance and higher efficiency. --> DURABLE AND SECURE High Quality Components Century series adopts 100% Japanese industrial level electronic capacitors for high durability, also achieve tight voltage and low ripple noise to enhance performance.    Moreover, it’s durable in high temperature and high pressure, therefore can effectively increase the lifespan of computer components. --> SILENT OPERATION AND LONGER LIFESPAN The advantage of using Fluid Dynamic Bearing (FDB) in the fan is to enhance the impact absorbance effects of oil. It generates less noise and heat than most of the other bearing. And, it can effectively reduce friction and vibration due to the lubrication of the bearing surface. Therefore, more reliable performance and considerably longer lifespan. --> USER FRIENDLY CABLING Fully modular cable set allows users to only attach the cables they need, reducing cable clutter and increasing airflow. --> Cables The modular cables are longer than normal power supply, makes the cable management even easier.
